{"check": "import io
import os
import dotenv
from dotenv.main import set_key, unset_key, dotenv_values

def test_crlf_update_and_remove(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\nB=keep\r\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A='new'\r\nB=keep\r\n"
    dotenv.unset_key(p, 'A')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b'B=keep\r\n'

def test_lf_update_and_remove(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\nB=keep\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A='new'\nB=keep\n"
    dotenv.unset_key(p, 'A')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b'B=keep\n'

def test_mixed_preserves_untouched(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\nB=keep\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A='new'\r\nB=keep\n"

def test_append_crlf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'B', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\r\nB='new'\r\n"

def test_append_lf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'B', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\nB='new'\n"

def test_append_no_newline_crlf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\nB=keep')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'C', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\r\nB=keep\r\nC='new'\r\n"

def test_append_no_newline_lf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\nB=keep')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'C', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A=old\nB=keep\nC='new'\n"

def test_empty_file_defaults_lf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', 'new')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"A='new'\n"

def test_export_crlf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\r\n')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', 'new', export=True)
    assert p.read_bytes() == b"export A='new'\r\n"

def test_backslash_roundtrip(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'')
    dotenv.set_key(p, 'A', "a\\b'")
    assert dotenv_values(p, interpolate=False)['A'] == "a\\b'"

def test_unset_preserves_lf(tmp_path):
    p = tmp_path / '.env'
    p.write_bytes(b'A=old\nB=keep\n')
    dotenv.unset_key(p, 'A')
    assert p.read_bytes() == b'B=keep\n'"}
